plan.notes: Official 'Degree Program Guide' (suggested 4-year curriculum) from the ODU 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog. All 8 semester grids transcribed verbatim; row sums match declared term totals (15/15/16/16/15/15/15/13); Total Credit Hours 120. Language and Culture I & II may be met in high school and are not included in this plan. Grade-of-C requirements are catalog requirement notes, not title text. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
